findings: Common expected receipt curves coincide in the certain and lottery cases.
All standard images are present with visible finite plotted series; the fixed-price housing excess demand is visible and is not presented as market clearing.

The stable native figure set retains crowded income legends and full wealth support to3000, which compresses the occupied region in policy plots. These are diagnostic figures, not publication-ready figures.
The supplemental plot distinguishes ownership and financial wealth before current choices from target moments measured after choices.
limits: Visual review does not replace the numerical gates or the finer-grid comparison. No claim of calibrated policy robustness.
